vBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-2284: boot-reconciliation Resume All reports 0 resumed — candidate list is full of stale (workspace-missing) and already-completed agents

plan.title: Boot-reconciliation candidate list excludes phantom (workspace-missing / merged / completed) agents; decision reports a skip breakdown
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-4-8

narratives.Problem: isBootReconciliationCandidate() gates only on role==='work' && status==='stopped' (plus paused/troubled/stoppedByUser). It does NOT apply the resumability predicates the resume path (handleAgentStoppedEvent) later enforces — workspace exists, not merged, no processed completion marker with passing review/test. So the boot-reconciliation modal is dominated by phantom rows (deleted workspaces, finished-and-merged agents), and 'Resume all' reports 0 resumed with no explanation, reading as a broken button. Structurally, the candidate predicate and the resume predicate are two drifted copies of the same intent, violating single-source-of-truth.
narratives.Proposal: Extract a single shared synchronous classifier bootReconciliationSkipReason(agent) covering the three terminal sync skip categories (workspace_missing, merged, completed). Consume it in isBootReconciliationCandidate so the modal shows only genuinely resumable agents (fixes the operator-facing bug), and delegate the resume path's corresponding checks to the same classifier so the two paths cannot drift again (no behavioral change). Additionally return a skip breakdown from POST /api/boot-reconciliation/decision and render it in BootReconciliationModal so any residual 0-resumed outcome is self-explanatory.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Do NOT add a janitor that deletes stale agents-registry rows whose workspace is gone (issue part 3 / #1846 / reconciliation inventory epic #2075/#2077) — deleting registry rows is a distinct higher-risk behavior owned by the agents write-door.
- Do NOT reduce the per-60s-patrol per-agent skip log spam (#1846).
- Do NOT make boot-time candidate enumeration async; async-only skips (issue-closed, tmux-alive) remain enforced by the resume path at apply time, not the candidate filter.
- Do NOT change grace-timer behavior or the 2-minute grace window (#2181).
- Do NOT change the resume path's actual skip/resume decisions — the delegation must be behavior-preserving.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix via one shared skip predicate consumed by both the candidate filter and the resume path, not a duplicated copy of the checks.
autoDecisions.rationale: The repo's single-source-of-truth tenet requires one read predicate; the bug's root cause is that the two paths drifted.

autoDecisions.summary: Classifier covers only the three terminal, synchronous categories: workspace_missing, merged, completed.
autoDecisions.rationale: These are the only skips the resume path always honors without an async lookup or a resume-flipping override; workspace_missing alone is ~28 of ~33 phantoms, so sync coverage captures the bug without going async (NFR-1).

autoDecisions.summary: Stale agents-registry-row janitor is out of scope; deferred to #1846 / #2075 / #2077.
autoDecisions.rationale: The candidate filter already removes phantoms from the modal (the operator-facing bug). Row deletion is a separate, riskier behavior with its own owner.

autoDecisions.summary: applyBootReconciliationDecision() return type changes from string[] to { resumed, skipped, deferred }.
autoDecisions.rationale: The function that iterates candidates is the only place that knows resumed-vs-skipped-with-reason; returning the breakdown there keeps categorization single-source via the classifier.

items.title: Add shared synchronous bootReconciliationSkipReason(agent) classifier

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/boot-reconciliation-predicates.ts exporting a type BootReconciliationSkipReason = 'workspace_missing' | 'merged' | 'completed' and a synchronous function bootReconciliationSkipReason(agent): BootReconciliationSkipReason | null. Return 'workspace_missing' when !agent.workspace || !existsSync(agent.workspace). Return 'merged' when getReviewStatusSync(agent.issueId)?.mergeStatus==='merged', OR (agent as {merged?:boolean}).merged===true, OR (review.readyForMerge && review.reviewStatus==='passed' && review.testStatus==='passed'). Return 'completed' when the agent-dir completion marker exists (existsSync(join(getAgentDir(agent.id),'completed')) || '...completed.processed') AND review.reviewStatus==='passed' && review.testStatus==='passed'. Otherwise return null. These mirror the terminal sync skips in handleAgentStoppedEvent (deacon-auto-resume.ts:641, 693, 706, 710, 715). Do NOT include issue-closed, tmux-alive, backoff, idle, or the completed+blocked→resume override. Confirm no import cycle via npm run build; if a cycle appears, keep the classifier in this dedicated module (it must not statically import deacon-auto-resume). Add a unit test covering each category and the null (genuinely-stopped) case.

items.title: bootReconciliationSkipReason returns 'workspace_missing' for an agent whose workspace path is null or does not exist on disk, and null for one whose workspace exists (all other fields clean)
Returns 'merged' when review.mergeStatus==='merged', when agent.merged===true, and when review is readyForMerge with reviewStatus and testStatus both 'passed'

Returns 'completed' only when an agent-dir completed (or completed.processed) marker exists AND review and test both 'passed'; returns null when the marker exists but review is 'blocked' (the resume-flipping case stays out of the classifier)
npm run build produces a bundle and logs no ESM import-cycle error, proving the classifier module introduces no cycle
isBootReconciliationCandidate excludes agents the classifier marks non-resumable

narrative.Action: In handleAgentStoppedEvent (deacon-auto-resume.ts:615-763), replace the inline workspace-missing check (641), the merge-ready/merged/state.merged checks (706/710/715), and the completed-marker-with-passing-review skip branch (693 only) with a single call to bootReconciliationSkipReason near the top, after the paused/troubled/tmux-liveness checks that must run first.
